answer: Random partner tasks: each epoch, the public beacon pairs every agent with a stranger, and they must co-write a short sonnet-length answer, each holding half the prompt. Pay arrives only when both partners sign that the other did real work. In a large network a sybil almost never draws its own sibling, so each fake must do genuine joint work with an honest agent who can refuse to sign. Like grafting onto a vine you do not own, the attacker pays full labor per identity.
